project: THE HOLLOW — Task 2 Production Environment Artwork
upscaling_disclosure: All 35 scenes were generated natively at 1376x768 (16:9) and upscaled to 2560x1440 (16:9) using Lanczos resampling with a restrained unsharp mask (radius=1.2, percent=45, threshold=2) to preserve crisp painterly brushwork on lit stone, timber, and metal surfaces while keeping shadow gradients smooth (#121316).

files.title: Living Forest
files.focal_landmark: Central winding mud-and-moss footpath framed by anatomically inward-leaning gnarled timber trunks beneath an ash-cloud moonlit break.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Establishes the Woods palette (desaturated moss green, wet dark bark, #121316 charcoal shadows). Upper-left canopy is kept dark for location UI text; lower 25% is open damp ground. Central path and leaning tree silhouettes survive 15–20% cropping.

files.title: Hunter’s Cabin
files.focal_landmark: Weathered timber cabin with porch lantern, stretched hide frame, antlers, steel traps, and chopping block.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Matches Living Forest tree anatomy and moonlit ash-cloud sky while introducing a warm directional porch lantern echoing Silent Square. Upper-left tree canopy is dark for UI text; lower quarter is open muddy track.

files.title: Witch’s Garden
files.focal_landmark: Timber lean-to apothecary worktable with stone mortar and lantern beside raised timber herb beds, clay pots, and glass bell jars.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Maintains Woods desaturated greens and wattle/dry-stone vernacular. Worktable and raised beds sit securely in the middleground to survive moderate cropping; upper-left foliage is dark for UI text.

files.title: Bone Orchard
files.focal_landmark: Rows of calcified, ash-pale orchard trees with bone-like interlocking branches and subtle skeletal remains entangled in the roots.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Shares the central path perspective of Living Forest (`forest.png`) for seamless regional navigation. Upper-left corner is deep shadow; lower quarter is open damp soil.

files.title: Moonwell
files.focal_landmark: Sunken monolithic stone ritual pool ringed by ancient standing stones and roots, reflecting bright pale moonlight.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Visually contrasted against Thornwick's raised cylindrical masonry well in Silent Square. Central mirror reflection anchors the composition; upper-left is dark canopy and lower quarter is open mossy bank.

files.title: Forgotten Battlefield
files.focal_landmark: Overgrown earth mounds with rusted medieval halberds, broken swords, tattered standards, and weathered stone cairn memorials.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Strictly pre-modern weaponry and standards reclaimed by damp moss. Central flooded rutted track connects visually to Woods paths; upper-left is dark for UI text and lower quarter is uncluttered.

files.title: Whispering Shrine
files.focal_landmark: Weathered timber-and-stone wayside shrine with eroded non-legible relief carvings, melted tallow candles, coins, and twig offerings.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: No legible text or symbols baked into the stone. Strong central silhouette with warm candle focal contrast against cold moonlight; upper-left and lower quarter kept clear.

files.title: Ruined Nave
files.focal_landmark: Monumental gothic nave with collapsed vaulted roof, massive compound piers, tarnished brass chandeliers, and distant high altar.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Establishes Abbey scale (far larger and older than Thornwick's chapel). Cold daylight from broken vault illuminates central aisle; upper-left vault is in deep shadow for UI text and lower quarter is open flagstone floor.

files.title: Spirit Fountain
files.focal_landmark: Octagonal carved gothic stone fountain basin with three tarnished brass spouts and subtle pale human-like reflections in the dark water.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Shares the gothic rib-vaulting and ivy-clad masonry of Ruined Nave (`nave.png`). Central basin survives moderate cropping; upper-left vault is dark and lower quarter is open cloister pavement.

files.title: Cursed Altar
files.focal_landmark: Raised monolithic stone altar with tarnished brass candlesticks, ritual blades, sacrificial bowl, and dark dried stains.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Represents the close-up apse focal point glimpsed at the end of Ruined Nave (`nave.png`). Restrained candlelight and cold lancet window shaft; no glowing neon symbols. Upper-left and lower quarter kept clear.

files.title: Cursed Reliquary
files.focal_landmark: Central cathedral-shaped tarnished brass and blackened silver reliquary chest on a stone plinth surrounded by tall oak reliquary cabinets.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Highlights tarnished brass and neglected gothic woodwork. Central reliquary plinth is spotlit by a cold window shaft and weak candles; upper-left vault is dark for UI text and lower quarter is open flagstone.

files.title: Ritual Chamber
files.focal_landmark: Octagonal chapter-house floor with concentric stone rings, recessed brass channels, four cardinal pedestals, and blank circular stone slabs.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Circular floor slabs and pedestals are intentionally left blank and uninscribed for runtime symbol overlays. Upper-left arch is in deep shadow; lower quarter is open flagstone approach.

files.title: Prison of Echoes
files.focal_landmark: Reinforced iron-barred focal cell in the center-right middleground lit by a warm wall lantern and overhead grate.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Transitions from the Abbey's upper masonry down toward the damp Crypt. Readable navigation corridor; upper-left vault is dark for UI text and lower quarter is wet flagstone walkway.

files.title: The Warden’s Lair
files.focal_landmark: Three massive iron chains anchored to heavy wall/arch winches converging on an open circular central staging floor.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Central floor is left unobstructed to stage the separately supplied Abbey Warden sprite, while clearly showing the three winch anchor points on the left pier, right pier, and upper arch.

files.title: Sealed Crypt
files.focal_landmark: Heavy iron-bound stone crypt doors with double sliding iron locking bars, corroded hinges, and raised stone threshold.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Connects the descending Abbey stairs on the left to the sealed Crypt entrance. Directly paired with `hidden_passage.png` and `ending_wipe.png`. Upper-left is dark; lower quarter is shallow puddle flagstone.

files.title: Ossuary Choir
files.focal_landmark: Tiered semi-circular apse alcoves and arches of carefully arranged dry skulls and long bones forming a monastic choir layout.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Communicates the choir motif purely through architectural bone arrangement without gore. Narrow cold top-light and weak tallow candles; upper-left is dark and lower quarter is wet flagstone.

files.title: Sunken Archive
files.focal_landmark: Submerged monastic library with chained folios, scroll cubbies, elevated timber walkways, and lantern-lit stone steps.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Unmistakably a flooded architectural archive rather than a generic cave. No legible writing on parchment. Upper-left masonry is dark for location text; lower quarter is shallow water and plank entry.

files.title: Flooded Hall
files.focal_landmark: Submerged vaulted colonnade with a raised stone stepping-slab causeway and lantern reflections leading to a distant archway.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Connects `sunken_archive.png` to `nameless_door.png` via the same flooded colonnade architecture and stepping-slab route. Upper-left vault is in deep shadow; lower quarter is causeway stones.

files.title: Father Venn’s Tomb
files.focal_landmark: Raised stone sarcophagus on a stepped dais with a brass crosier, thurible censer, prayer beads, chalice, and blank inscription tablet.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: The recessed rectangular inscription panel on the side of the sarcophagus is left completely blank for in-game text. Upper-left vault is dark; lower quarter is wet flagstone floor.

files.title: Hidden Passage
files.focal_landmark: Pivoted false ashlar masonry block on an iron floor track with counterweight chain and scrape marks revealing a secret ascending stair.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Shares the exact architectural framing and left-hand stair of `sealed_crypt.png`, showing how the concealed masonry mechanism pivots open beside the main crypt threshold.

files.title: The Nameless Door
files.focal_landmark: Colossal monolithic basalt-and-iron doorway at the end of the flooded causeway with its central medallion and lintel violently chiseled blank.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct architectural culmination of `flooded_hall.png`. Surface is deliberately gouged and stripped of identity with zero letters or inscriptions. Upper-left is dark; lower quarter is causeway approach.

files.title: The Weeping Stair
files.focal_landmark: Sweeping descending staircase carved into ribbed organic dark stone with dark iron railing and tear-like mineral condensation rivulets.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Introduces the Heart's biomechanical/organic ribbed stone, dark iron, and restrained rust-red mineral accents. Upper-left cavern wall is dark for UI text; lower quarter is top landing.

files.title: Hall of Names
files.focal_landmark: Central monolithic stone memorial stelae and tiered wall alcoves of dark-iron and bronze nameplates—all left completely blank.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Every tablet and nameplate is uninscribed so the game engine can populate real names dynamically. Ribbed organic piers with rust-red mineral seams; upper-left dark and lower quarter clear.

files.title: The Still Lake
files.focal_landmark: Glass-calm black subterranean lake reflecting monumental ribbed organic stone arches, with a foreground stone shore and iron-ringed pier.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Shares the ribbed cavern vaulting and foreground stone platform language of `heart_chamber.png`. Razor-sharp mirror reflection in the center survives cropping; upper-left and lower quarter kept clear.

files.title: Pit of Remembered Things
files.focal_landmark: Deep stepped subterranean shaft with recognizable personal objects along the rim and ledges (wooden cradle, pocket watch, lutes, boots, satchels, lantern).
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Objects are staged with distinct, readable silhouettes along the iron-bound stone rim rather than visual noise. Upper-left cavern opening is dark for UI text; lower quarter is open stone approach.

files.title: The Cold Forge
files.focal_landmark: Colossal dark-iron anvil on a stone block, stone quenching basin, rack of heavy tongs/hammers, and hearth filled with cold ash-white embers.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: No orange fire; lit by restrained cold pale-gray illumination from the hearth and subtle rust-red mineral accents on the lower stone. Upper-left is dark; lower quarter is open stone floor.

files.title: The Heart Chamber
files.focal_landmark: The monumental Missing Bell suspended above the chasm by four taut dark-iron chains anchored to the ribbed cavern walls, approached by a central stone platform.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Canonical Bell and chamber design used across `ending_silence.png`, `ending_reverse.png`, `ending_bargain.png`, and `ending_destroy.png`. Contrasts with Thornwick's empty belfry in Silent Square.

files.title: Chapter One — The Missing Bell (Establishing View)
files.intended_location: Chapter — Chapter One — The Missing Bell (Establishing View)
files.focal_landmark: Elevated approach road overlooking Thornwick village, the roadside lantern, the central square well, and the distant leaning empty bell tower.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Preserves the exact architecture of Silent Square from an establishing vantage point. Wide uncluttered dark sky in the upper-left/center is reserved for the 'The Missing Bell' title overlay (no baked-in text).

files.title: Ending — Silence
files.focal_landmark: The monumental Bell resting upright on the central stone platform with slackened iron chains draped across the floor under calm pale daylight.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct state variant of `heart_chamber.png`. Rust-red tension lighting is replaced by calm, clear pale light from above and slackened chains.

files.title: Ending — Reverse
files.focal_landmark: The monumental Bell restoring to burnished bronze as vertical streams of pale golden dust and stone fragments rise steadily toward the upper light.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct state variant of `heart_chamber.png`. Depicts controlled, physical, architectural reversal/restoration without chaotic neon effects.

files.title: Ending — Bargain
files.focal_landmark: Small cloaked human silhouette holding a warm lantern at the edge of the platform beneath the suspended Bell as a long shadow reaches back across the stone.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct state variant of `heart_chamber.png`. The only scene with an explicitly requested small human silhouette, illustrating the ambiguous exchange of warm lantern light and encroaching shadow.

files.title: Ending — Destroy
files.focal_landmark: The monumental Bell crashed and fractured on the central stone platform with broken bronze shards, detached iron clapper, snapped chains, and settling dust.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct state variant of `heart_chamber.png`. Preserves the exact timber yoke, bell profile, and cavern geometry while showing believable heavy metal fracture.

files.title: Ending — Escape
files.focal_landmark: Mud-rutted road passing through Thornwick's open iron boundary gate with a warm post lantern, pale dawn ahead, and the mist-shrouded empty bell tower behind.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Maintains Thornwick's exact bell tower silhouette on the left horizon while leading the eye outward through the boundary gate toward the pale horizon break.

files.title: Ending — Doom
files.focal_landmark: Thornwick's Silent Square overtaken by ribbed organic dark stone tendrils and rust-red fissures erupting from the central well and wrapping the bell tower.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Direct transformation of the approved Task 1 Silent Square reference (`Gemini_Generated_Image_knjak0knjak0knja.png`), fusing the Heart's organic stone and rust-red glow into the village architecture.

files.title: Ending — Wipe
files.focal_landmark: Abandoned expedition gear on wet crypt flagstones—overturned dying brass lantern, blank open journal, coiled rope, dented canteen, and broken staff—before an empty stair.
files.continuity_and_crop_notes: Shares the masonry and ascending stair architecture of `sealed_crypt.png`. Communicates expedition failure through abandoned gear with zero dead bodies or gore.
